notes.title: New Patch!
notes.notes:
A new patch has just launched for Monster Jam Steel Titans 2.

[list]
[*] Added "Playground Mode" (Free Roam with all Trucks and Areas unlocked, accessible via gameplay settings)
[*] Various AI bugfixes & improvements
[*] Various Audio bugfixes & improvements
[*] Various misc bugfixes
[/list]
